usageNotes: Use this to overwrite `/etc/hosts` on a specific Proxmox node — for example, to add or update static hostname-to-IP mappings needed before DNS is available, or to propagate cluster-wide hostname entries to a node that hasn't rejoined DNS yet. The caller must hold `Sys.Modify` on `/nodes/{node}`. Always retrieve the current file first (via `get_nodes_node_hosts`) and pass its digest to prevent concurrent-write conflicts.

examples.summary: Add a static host entry for a new VM to pve1's /etc/hosts

params.data:
127.0.0.1 localhost
::1 localhost ip6-localhost ip6-loopback

192.168.10.10 pve1.lab.local pve1
192.168.10.11 pve2.lab.local pve2
192.168.10.100 vm-web01.lab.local vm-web01

tips: Fetch the current content and digest with get_nodes_node_hosts before writing — the digest field is your optimistic-lock guard against concurrent edits.
Returns null on success; any HTTP error (403, 500) means the write did not occur.
Changes take effect immediately — no service restart required — but only affect the targeted node; repeat the call for each node in the cluster.
The `data` field must contain the complete file content, not just new lines; partial updates are not supported.
